summary: MaintSiteProfile is a multi-tab ASP.NET page for managing site profiles. It presents key pieces of site information such as general details, descriptions, closures, requirements, documents, contacts, recruitment resources and opportunities, history, and SSO settings. Access is governed through user session properties and database flags. Business logic is distributed between UI controls, server-side code and validation routines.
purpose: To provide a centralized management interface for site profiles, allowing authorized users to update, view, and maintain various aspects of a site (address, contacts, recruitment, history, documents, requirements, etc.) in a structured, permission-based workflow.

workflows.name: Site Profile Management
steps: Page initializes with user session and optional alternate database.
Tabs (General, Description, Closures, Requirements, Documents, Contacts, Recruitment, History, SSO) are enabled/disabled based on user role and database configuration.
Each tab loads a user control, which retrieves and displays site information based on SiteID.
Site controls are data-bound and visibility is toggled based on the presence of site data.
Editing/Updating is allowed if permissions and conditions are met (such as user role, agency match, absence of service users, QES flag, etc.)
Validations run for requirements, contact details, dates, etc. before updates.
Recruitment tabs are enabled if recruitment is configured and recruitment contact exists.
Administrators or authorized users can update details, requirements, contacts, closures, documents, recruitment, and history through respective controls.

business_rules: TabPanelContact is enabled if user is not a StudentUser and not using alternate database.
TabPanelSso is enabled only if SSO is configured and user is SystemAdministrator.
Tabs are activated based on 'currentPage' query parameter.
Only SystemAdministrator, StaffAdmin, and authorized ReceivingUser can edit sites, based on SiteAgencyID and SiteID checks.
PlacementCoordinator with LocalAdministrator role can edit sites if no service users exist.
Recruitment tab enabled if recruitment is configured and exists for the site.
Edit icons/buttons visibility controlled by RecruitmentIsEditable flag.
Data binding and visibility conditions for each panel depend on site data existence flags.
validations: Document sub-discipline validation: must select included items if 'AllowAllDisciplines' is set.
Requirement description validation: if 'OtherRequirementCodeID' is selected, description must be non-empty.
Date validation: StartDate must be before MaxDate; EndDate must be before MaxDate; StartDate <= EndDate.
Recruitment contact email and phone formatting and validation.
Data-bound controls validate presence of required fields before save.
conditions: Tabs enabled/disabled based on user roles and alternate database usage.
Recruitment editing is allowed if not using alternate database, not read-only, and user is SystemAdministrator or StaffAdmin with site match.
Screen editing allowed if QES flag is set, PlacementCoordinator+LocalAdministrator, or user is authorized for the site.
Panel and field visibility determined by data existence flags.
system_behavior: Page_Load initializes session, database, and loads site info.
Tabs dynamically enabled/disabled and activated based on query parameters and session.
Child controls link to appropriate site data and data-binding occurs on page load and tab change.
Panel visibility and editability is managed by business logic in code-behind.
UserControls fetch, display, and allow editing of relevant site data, subject to workflow constraints.
Site data updates handled through FormView and ObjectDataSource with event hooks for updating and selecting.
dependencies: UserSession object for permissions and context.
Configuration codes for SSO and Recruitment.
Child UserControls for each tab (general, details, closures, documents, contacts, recruitment, history, SSO).
GridView and FormView components for data display and updates.
Database stored procedures for select, insert, update, delete operations.
exceptions: Site controls and editing are restricted if user is StudentUser or using alternate database.
Edit permissions denied if placing user in own agency without proper role.
Editing denied if service users exist for the site (for PlacementCoordinator+LocalAdmin).
Recruitment editing denied if recruitment contact does not exist or recruitment not configured.
Visibility and functionality suppressed for users without required session roles.
content_gaps: No detailed field descriptions or data models for each UserControl (websites, details, closures, requirements, documents, contacts, recruitment resources/opportunities, history, SSO) are present.
Some referenced stored procedures and database logic (e.g. SiteDocumentAddDoc, SiteRequirementAdd, etc.) are not defined.
Details of possible exception messages or error handling routines are missing.
No explicit sample of site record or tab content is available.
